title: Demonic Overlord on Battlefield
description: A towering demonic warrior with large curved horns, glowing red eyes, and massive bat-like wings stands amid a chaotic battlefield. He wears ornate black armor with glowing orange cracks, wields a enormous glowing golden sword embedded in the blood-soaked ground, and is surrounded by skulls, broken weapons, burning debris, and purple magical energy.
